# omergulcicek.com

> Personal website and blog of Ömer Gülçiçek, Frontend Engineer (Frontend Mühendisi). React, Next.js, TypeScript, TanStack Start, and modern web development. Technical articles (mostly Turkish), project showcases, experience timeline, and curated bookmarks. Built with TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn/ui.

Primary sections: Home (/), Blog (/blog), Projects (/projects), Bookmarks (/bookmarks), About (/about), Experiences (/experiences), Journey (/journey), Setup (/setup). Blog posts cover React, Next.js, CSS, frontend architecture, state management, TanStack, forms, accessibility, and developer tooling.

## Main pages

- [About](https://omergulcicek.com/about): Bio, working principles, how to work together, and contact links
- [Experiences](https://omergulcicek.com/experiences): Career timeline and downloadable CV
- [Projects](https://omergulcicek.com/projects): Personal apps and ViraStack open-source tools
- [Journey](https://omergulcicek.com/journey): Career and life milestones by year
- [Setup](https://omergulcicek.com/setup): Tools and technologies used for development
- [Bookmarks](https://omergulcicek.com/bookmarks): Curated frontend resources on Raindrop

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://omergulcicek.com/blog): Full list of published articles
